description:
Totals, rankings and trends of US federal spending (contracts, grants, loans, direct
    payments) by state, county, city, agency, bureau, company, industry (NAICS), product (PSC),
    program or fiscal year, from USAspending.gov: e.g. "which states got the most Department of
    Transportation grant money in FY2025", "top 10 Army contractors in Virginia", "VA IT spending
    by year since 2023", "how much did NASA give the University of Colorado". Write the plan from
    get_catalog's plan_schema. Returns status (ok | clarify | unsupported | error), a
    one-paragraph answer, columns, rows (max 100), the SQL that ran, caveats, how names were
    resolved to codes, and `page`: the same answer on spendquery.com, run live, to cite or open.

plan.description: A QueryPlan object in business terms, following get_catalog's plan_schema, e.g. {"intent": "aggregate", "metric": "obligations", "group_by": ["agency"], "fiscal_years": [2025], "award_category": "contract"} (award_category is a field of its own, not a filter).
plan.title: Plan

name: run_plan
title: Run a spending query
